issues: Food source is the 2026 menu only; no prices and no '*' notes/footnotes are printed anywhere in the Royal Blue Sea documents, so priceUsd is null for all items and footnotes is empty.
2026 heading 'MAKARNALAR / PASTAS,' has a stray trailing comma in the source; removed from the category name.
2026 food items printed with one name only (no Turkish/English pair), put identically in tr and en: Chef Burger, Cheese Burger, Steak Sandwich, Fettuccine Alfredo, Magnolia, San Sebastian Cheesecake.

Sezar Salata: the 2026 line has two option lines ('(İsteğe bağlı karidesli / tavuklu / bonfile dilimli)' and '(Optional: with shrimp / chicken / sliced beef)'); appended to detailTr/detailEn after ' — '. Printed order was TR description, TR option, EN description, EN option.
Drinks file is a one-sheet spreadsheet; the title row 'POOL & BEACH BEVERAGE MENU' is a document title, not a category, and was not stored.

Drinks: most names are printed in one language only (brands, AMERICANO, AYRAN, COCA COLA, beers, spirits, liqueurs, cocktail names); copied identically into tr and en. Bilingual headings/items were split at '/'.
Drinks: 'SU / WATER 330 ml.' and 'SU / WATER 750 ml.' split at '/', so the volume appears only in en ('WATER 330 ml.'); tr is 'SU'. Needs a human decision on how to show the volume.

Drinks: 'SODA / MINERAL WATER' is followed by 'SAN PELLEGRINO'; unclear whether it is a brand detail of the soda item or a separate item. Stored as the detail of the soda item. 'BRITVIC' is followed by 'TOMATO, BITTER LEMON, GINGER ALE, TONIC' (stored as detail).

Drinks: 'MEYVE SUYU / FRUIT JUICE' (10 flavours) and the first 'FRESH MEYVE SUYU / FRESH FRUIT JUICE' (4 flavours) sit inside MEŞRUBATLAR; their flavour rows (TR row, EN row) are stored as detailTr/detailEn. A second 'FRESH MEYVE SUYU / FRESH FRUIT JUICE' (7 flavours, GREYFURT ... KARIŞIK) appears after HOT DRINKS with different flavours; stored as its own category, one item per flavour. The same heading therefore occurs twice with different content.

Drinks: SERİNLETİCİ SMOOTHIE, DONDURMALAR, MILKSHAKES flavour rows (TR row, EN row) were split into one item per flavour by position; both rows had equal counts (10, 11, 9). 'MILKSHAKES' is printed once without a Turkish heading.

Signature and international cocktails: ingredient row is English for PORT, ROYAL, PASSION, AURA and all international cocktails, but Turkish for ILLUSION and HARMONY; since only one language is printed it was put identically into detailTr and detailEn. Typos kept as printed: HIBUSKUS, APREROL, CAIRPIRINHA, BLOODY MARRY, LYNCBURG, WORCHESTER, TOBASCO, ANGUSTURO, VOTKA, 'GI' (in LONG ISLAND ICE TEA), NENE YAPRAKLARI, FRANGELİCO, GRANDE ABSENTH, BATI DE COCO, 'APERATİFLER / APERATIVES', 'LYNCBURG  LEMONADE' (doubled space collapsed).
'ULUSLARASI KOKTEYLLER/ INTERNATIONAL COCKTAILS': no space before '/' in source; split normally. 'ICE TEA (PEACH, LEMON)' is one item with the flavours in the printed name.

Photo caption file (2026_royal_snack_a_la_carte_grselleri_docx.txt) is extracted with each caption doubled (e.g. 'TEMPURA TABAĞITEMPURA TABAĞI'). Dishes named there that are NOT in the 2026 menu: 'İNCİ MENÜ', '2 TEK MENÜ', 'EGE SALATASI', 'DOMATES SOSLU SPAGETTHİ', 'TOST TABAĞI', 'BURGER TABAĞI' (appears 4 times). 'KÖFTE IZGARA' probably = Tekirdağ Köfte Izgara. Other captions map to 2026 items with different wording (SPAGETTHİ BOLOGNESE, FETTUCHİNİ ALFREDO, STEAK SANDVİÇ, DENİZ ÜRÜNŞERİ SALATASI [sic], KARPUZLU EZİNE SALATASI, KENTUCKY, ACILI KANAT, KITIR PANE, etc.).
